templates.T001: Minimal success case: request {action} in a valid initial state and provide only mandatory parameters; verify the result described above through an independent read of the application state.
templates.T002: Nominal complete: fill in all compatible parameters, compare each one to the result; do not combine mutually exclusive options without consulting the handler.
templates.T003: Unknown field in the MCP request: verify the rejection required by additionalProperties=false; distinguish this rejection from normalization by the internal engine.
templates.T004: Executor failure: inject a deterministic error from the affected port; explicit response, no success announcement, and no collateral mutation.
templates.T005: Lost response or repeated request: observe the effects before retrying; do not confuse repeatability with idempotence or duplicate an unrequested effect.
templates.T006: Concurrent state: modify the target or close the document between reading and action; re-read or refuse explicitly, without acting on another object.
templates.T007: Cancelled request before execution: do not launch the action; test separately a late cancellation, which does not guarantee cancellation of an already realized effect.
templates.T008: Missing parameter {field}: verify rejection or a clarification request before the operation is called, according to its contract.
templates.T009: Parameter {field} with null and an incompatible type: check MCP request validation and, separately, handler validation; ensure there are no unintended partial effects.
templates.T010: Option of {field}: {value}; compatible fixture, precisely verify the corresponding business branch.
templates.T011: Unknown option of {field}: verify rejection, no silent selection of a nearby option.
templates.T012: Text {field}: empty text, spaces, accents, Unicode, a long name and punctuation; check validation and preservation according to the field's semantics.
templates.T013: Missing parameter {field}: check the actual default or preservation of the current value; do not invent a default.
templates.T014: Value of {field}: zero, negative, fractional and very large but finite; verify unit, precision and business constraints, without presuming they are all valid.
templates.T015: List {field}: empty, one element, several elements, duplicates and an invalid element; check the order, deduplication and atomicity specified by the actual contract.
templates.T016: Boolean {field}: true then false with initially opposite state; verify both effects and do not treat false as a missing parameter.
templates.T017: Target {field}: valid identifier, absent, obsolete, other document/project and two identical names; resolve the real identifier, clarify ambiguity, protect the nearby target.
templates.T018: Consent: agreement, refusal, absence of response and modification of the request after agreement; verify the real confirmation mechanism before sensitive effects, without inventing a consent field.
templates.T019: Missing preparation or dynamic constraint: test each branch of the handler callback; the runtimeFunction marker in the catalog does not reveal these branches.
templates.T020: Missing or incompatible context: no active surface, a document of another type, a closed target; check the actual precondition and an actionable explanation.
templates.T021: Bound {bound} of {field} = {value}: exact value and values on both sides; verify rejection or clamp according to the real contract, and the result actually stored.
